nodes.label: Embedding Configuration
nodes.rationale: Configures sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 on CPU with 384 dimensions and batch size 32 for local lightweight embedding.

nodes.label: LLM Configuration
nodes.rationale: Configures Ollama with llama3.1:8b-instruct-q4_K_M at http://localhost:11434/v1 with low temperature (0.1) for deterministic extraction.

nodes.label: Graph Clustering Configuration
nodes.rationale: Configures Leiden community detection with resolution 1.0, min community size 2, and similarity threshold 0.70.

nodes.label: Hybrid Retrieval Configuration
nodes.rationale: Balances dense vector similarity and keyword search with hybrid_alpha 0.5 and top_k 8.

nodes.label: OCR Engine Configuration
nodes.rationale: Configures Tesseract engine with PSM 6, balanced speed mode, 300 DPI, table detection, and layout preservation.

nodes.label: FastAPI & Uvicorn API Stack
nodes.rationale: High-performance asynchronous ASGI web framework for serving graph and query endpoints.

nodes.label: Sentence-Transformers & Gensim NLP
nodes.rationale: Sentence-level dense embeddings (SBERT) and Word2Vec baseline embeddings for NLP.

nodes.label: FAISS & NetworkX Storage Stack
nodes.rationale: In-memory graph manipulation with NetworkX and dense vector indexing with faiss-cpu.

nodes.label: Leidenalg & Python-Louvain Clustering
nodes.rationale: Community detection algorithms providing modularity optimization and Leiden partitioning.

nodes.label: Aiosqlite Storage Engine
nodes.rationale: Async local-first SQLite driver supporting FTS5 full-text indexing.

nodes.label: OCR & Document Parsing Stack
nodes.rationale: Pytesseract, pdf2image, Pillow, OpenCV, pypdf, and mistune for PDF and image ingestion.

nodes.label: DriftGraph Architecture
nodes.rationale: Reconstructs knowledge graphs using note embeddings streamed to browser with zero cloud dependency.

nodes.label: ObsidianGalaxyEngine Canvas
nodes.rationale: Custom layered HTML5 Canvas 2D engine running at 60 FPS with dual-level abstraction (Level 0 Communities and Level 1 Entities).

nodes.label: GraphRAG Dual-Engine Q&A
nodes.rationale: Global Map-Reduce synthesis for macro themes and Local Search traversing entity neighborhoods, FAISS similarity, and SQLite FTS5.

nodes.label: Latent Semantic Auto-Linking
nodes.rationale: Dynamically links notes when cosine similarity across SBERT embeddings exceeds threshold >= 0.70.

nodes.label: Multi-Engine Document OCR Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Ingests PDFs and images via multi-engine fallback (Tesseract, EasyOCR, DocTR) with column layout analysis.

nodes.label: Voice Assistant RAG
nodes.rationale: Speech Recognition API queries grounded graph context and streams ElevenLabs TTS audio with canvas node spotlighting.

nodes.label: Offline Taxonomy Classification Studio
nodes.rationale: 100% offline rule-based classification studio with confidence meters and ASCII decision trees.

nodes.label: Embedding Ablation & RAGAS Benchmarking
nodes.rationale: Ablation comparing SBERT against Word2Vec and TF-IDF, evaluating RAGAS metrics (Context Precision, Faithfulness, Answer Relevance).

nodes.label: Dual-Route Query Routing and RAG Search
nodes.norm_label: dual-route query routing and rag search

nodes.label: Global Search Retrieval Strategy
nodes.rationale: Evaluates hierarchical Leiden community summaries to synthesize comprehensive answers for broad, holistic questions.

nodes.label: Local Search Retrieval Strategy
nodes.rationale: Performs hybrid FAISS vector and SQLite FTS5 keyword retrieval followed by 1-hop knowledge graph expansion for entity-centric queries.

nodes.label: Grounded Synthesis and Citations
nodes.rationale: References citations with note titles, source types, and confidence scores to ground responses and prevent LLM hallucinations.

nodes.label: GraphRAG Pipeline Stages
nodes.rationale: Combines semantic ingestion, entity-relation triple extraction, hierarchical Leiden community detection, Map-Reduce summarization, and dual-route retrieval.

nodes.label: Entity and Relation Extraction
nodes.rationale: Language models extract subject-predicate-object triples to map domain concepts and directed relationships across documents.

nodes.label: Map-Reduce Community Summarization
nodes.rationale: High-level community summaries generated in parallel enable global thematic synthesis across personal notes.

nodes.label: Leiden Community Detection Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Guarantees well-connected communities, eliminates disconnected sub-communities from Louvain, converges rapidly, and supports resolution tuning.

nodes.label: Multi-Level Resolution Tuning
nodes.rationale: Tunable resolution parameter controls cluster granularity to produce hierarchical levels from macro topics to micro sub-themes.

nodes.label: Knowledge Graph Community Partitioning
nodes.rationale: Partitions NetworkX knowledge graph, assigns color palettes, and summarizes communities via Map-Reduce LLM prompts.

nodes.label: Embedded SQLite & FTS5 Tenet
nodes.rationale: Stores all graph nodes, edges, notes, and community summaries locally in driftgraph.db with ACID transactions and full-text search.

nodes.label: Zero Mandatory Cloud Dependency
nodes.rationale: Runs entirely on-device by default using local Ollama models and local embedding models with optional hosted demo mode.

nodes.label: Interactive Client-Side Canvas
nodes.rationale: Cytoscape.js and HTML5 dual-canvas engines perform force-directed layout and 60 FPS physics directly inside browser.

nodes.label: Sentence-BERT 384-d Dense Embeddings
nodes.rationale: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 produces 384-dimensional dense vectors capturing conceptual nuances and semantic proximity.
